page_title: MAI 2-2 WOL | Mainz v Wolfsburg 19/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for an infringement. Mainz have a free kick.
90+3' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+2' Substitution. Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) leaves the pitch and is replaced by Arnaud Nordin.
90+1' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) receives a yellow card!
89' 2 - 2 Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 2:2.
89' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
89' Bo Henriksen has decided to make a change. Silvan Widmer (Mainz) replaces Nikolas Veratschnig.
88' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
86' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
85' The referee signals a substitution. Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Mattias Svanberg.
83' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the left side of the goal is far too weak and Kamil Grabara makes a simple save.
83' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
79' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
79' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is about to take a corner kick.

78' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Kamil Grabara tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
77' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
76' It will be a substitution. Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) is ready to enter the pitch as Dominik Kohr walks off.
76' Bo Henriksen has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hyun-Seok Hong (Mainz) replacing Nelson Weiper.
74' The attendance for today's match is 32000.
74' The game has come to an end for Jonas Wind. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg).
73' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
71' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) commits a rough challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for an infringement.
70' One of the Mainz players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. It's a free kick to Wolfsburg, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
68' Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Zwayer had an easy-decision to make.
68' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
67' A lofted pass finds Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails well wide of the left post.
65' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
65' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball. Mainz have a corner.
63' The manager makes a subsitution with Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) coming on for Patrick Wimmer.
63' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Mohamed Amoura and he is replaced by Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg).
63' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Kevin Paredes leaves the pitch to be replaced by Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg).
63' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
62' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Mainz.
61' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
60' Moritz Jenz (Mainz) misses a golden opportunity after his strike hits the post!
57' PENALTY APPEAL by Mainz, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
56' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
51' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
51' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dominik Kohr (Mainz) was quite harsh and Felix Zwayer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' A player from Mainz takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Wolfsburg are awarded a free kick.
49' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
48' The free kick from long range, taken by Mainz, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
48' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) is penalised for holding. Felix Zwayer signals a set piece. There is a free kick near the sideline to Mainz.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' Kamil Grabara blocks Nelson Weiper (Mainz)'s effort from the edge of the box.
45+5' Wolfsburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+2' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
45+2' Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) trips an opposition player and Felix Zwayer signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Wolfsburg.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
40' 2 - 1 Dominik Kohr (Mainz) meets the well-taken corner kick and quickly shoots towards the goal. His effort goes into the bottom right corner. What a finish!
39' Mainz force a corner. They send men into the box.
37' 1 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) was set free in the area by Nelson Weiper and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the left side of the net. 1:1.
31' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
30' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Robin Zentner has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
30' Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg) takes a direct free kick.
28' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) makes a strong challenge and Felix Zwayer blows for a foul.
26' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) attempts to find Jae-Sung Lee, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
25' Robin Zentner (Mainz) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
24' Robin Zentner (Mainz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.

19' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
19' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
17' The ball goes out of play. Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.
16' Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal.
15' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch.
14' Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Wolfsburg will take a free kick near the side line.
14' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
12' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Felix Zwayer signals. Wolfsburg earn a free kick.
11' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
10' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) strikes the ball towards goal from distance, but it goes over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
5' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
4' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch.

3' 0 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom right corner. Robin Zentner just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:1.
1' The first half has started.
Mainz will kick-off.
Felix Zwayer was nominated as the referee for this game.
